scenarios.reasoning: The agent performed reasonable mechanical steps (finding the binlog, querying errors, listing projects, checking properties) but arrived at incorrect conclusions on the key analytical questions. It incorrectly stated LrgWindowsAppManifest was built as part of the solution, failed to identify configuration mismatches as the root cause, and didn't connect the fundamental insight that the project being absent from the solution build leads to wrong output paths. The root cause analysis was superficial and incorrect.
scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path
